item: After a panic wipe that keeps a data drive's key in memory (its connections pinned, R813), the app closes itself
summary: POST /api/safety/panic with drive_key_in_memory: exit_after_panic arms the power button's graceful stop (3 s, so the answer reaches the page) and a watchdog that ends the process 20 s later if it is still running (worker processes reaped first). The answer carries app_closing and the limit says S8 (x12 on the page). The CLI ends anyway. Before: the key stayed until the operator closed the app.
